address: Doctor José Naveiras 38, Santa Cruz de Tenerife, 38001, Spain
bio: In the north of the city, inside a neo-Canarian style villa located in the gardens adjacent to the iconic Iberostar Heritage Grand Mencey, this restaurant surprises both for its elegant interior with a contemporary aesthetic and for its culinary offerings, focused on Japanese cuisine but with elements of fusion (on the menu you will find nigiri, maki, sashimi, robata specialities, etc.). In the bar area, several chefs prepare cold dishes live!...
